note: Intesa Sanpaolo's information sheet for XME Conto (updated 1 October 2026): a basic monthly fee of 8.50 euros (102 a year); the stamp duty of 34.20 euros a year is a tax, not modelled here, and the reductions for a salary or pension credited (3 euros) or for exclusive cards and managed portfolios aren't modelled. Read again 2026-10-30 (updated 1 October 2026): the account pays 0% a year; withdrawals at Group and other banks' machines cost nothing in this sheet (it also lists an optional monthly flat fee for other banks' machines, not taken); a SEPA transfer in euros online to another bank costs nothing, a transfer in another currency 12.00 EUR (written as the transfer abroad; one in euros outside the EU/EEA carries no fixed fee in this sheet); using money with no arranged overdraft costs 20.28% a year up to 5,000 EUR (20.31% above) with no fast-review commission (CIV 0). This sheet says the XME Conto is reserved, until 31 December 2026, for customers moved to Isybank in October 2023 and returning: the existing reading of which account a newcomer opens is the lead's to check. Not stated: a returned payment, the card's share on another currency, what opening asks.
